sections.h2: India's naphtha exports to China rose 101% in FY2025-26

chart.title: Naphtha exports to China were flat to falling, then reversed in FY2025-26

sections.means: Naphtha exports to China reached $2,425.0mn in FY2025-26, up from $1,207.1mn the year before.
sections.todo: What to do: name paracetamol and ibuprofen route KSMs as targets in an import-substitution scheme, as the post proposes.

sections.h2: Benzene exports to China rose 4.5× since FY2022-23

chart.title: Benzene exports to China have risen every year since FY2022-23
chart.sub: Benzene exports to China, US$ million.

sections.means: Benzene exports reached $220.6mn in FY2025-26, up from $49.5mn in FY2022-23.
sections.todo: What to do: design market rules that route naphtha and benzene to domestic KSM plants before they reach a paying foreign buyer.

sections.h2: Isobutylbenzene exports to China fell every year, down 82.6% since FY2022-23

chart.title: Isobutylbenzene, the ibuprofen starting material, moves opposite to naphtha and benzene
chart.sub: Isobutylbenzene exports to China, US$ million.

sections.means: Isobutylbenzene exports to China fell from $22.4mn in FY2022-23 to $3.9mn in FY2025-26.
sections.todo: What to do: keep ibuprofen's starting material at home and track whether the 80.73% China import dependence keeps falling.
